items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He had Buddy Matty was playing banjo. Little Chester was playing bass. And Little Pills was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: Well at that time he had, well I've been playing with Buddy Petit. He had a fella by the name of George Washington was playing trombone.
He had Buddy Matty was playing banjo. Little Chester was playing bass. And Little Pills was playing clarinet.
Pills, did he have any name? What was his real name?

items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: We used to call him Cripple Pills. Quacko was his name... He had a good band.

ctx.x: Pills, did he have any name? What was his real name?

I don't know. I don't know. We used to call him Cripple Pills. Quacko was his name. Huh? Quacko. Quacko, I don't know. Well anyway, that's the part I could remember. We used to call him Pills, you know. He had a good band.
He had a good band, didn't he?
